kappa.label: kappa
kappa.role: odd central element of the inhomogeneous extension A = V + C K + C kappa; carries the deformation (Schema 2). Not a basis element of g; first in PBW order.

K.label: K
K.relation: [K, X} = 0 for all X; identified with the scalar 1
K.role: even central element (constant term of oscillator words). Excluded from basis lists; appears as a bracket target label only in Schemas 2-4 when a constant term arises.

evaluated_deformation.target: g + C K (entries with Z = 'K' are constant terms)

references: Frappat, Sciarrino, Sorba (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras, arXiv:hep-th/9607161
